Strategy: Refine the distribution-plus-worst-fit family with a mean gate: an exact fit wins, otherwise bins at or above the mean compete by looseness, while bins below the mean use Best Fit but lose to an above-mean bin. The choice differs from Best Fit whenever a bin sits above the mean, since the loosest such bin wins. Favoring above-mean bins may preserve tight bins, but it can ignore a nearly exact fit sitting below the mean.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mean = sum(bins) / len(bins)
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) + (r if r >= mean else -(r - item) - 1000) for r in bins]
```
